name: New Mexico School Products.
old_description: New Mexico School Products uses your blueprints and meets with you on site to plan for new or upgraded classroom layouts, seating, and storage. This is a complimentary part of our services.
about:
New Mexico School Products was founded in 1968 in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The company began as a full-coverage furniture provider for educational, government, and private institutional markets. Over the 1970s, its product lines and staff expanded to meet growing demand.

In 1986, the company established its own manufacturing plant, FAME Mfg., enabling in-house production of a customizable furniture line. Today, New Mexico School Products designs, builds, supplies, and installs furniture for classrooms, libraries, gymnasiums, cafeterias, and theaters. It combines its FAME product line with offerings from premier manufacturing partners to deliver both off-the-shelf and custom solutions. The operation includes complimentary on-site space planning using client blueprints and free ergonomic assessments for teachers and administrators.

The company serves educational institutions, government agencies, and private organizations across the United States. Projects have included schools, libraries, gymnasiums, cafeterias, and theaters. It also supplies automotive parts storage units, indicating a presence in the industrial storage market.

New Mexico School Products emphasizes quality through FAME Manufacturing’s participation in the Architectural Woodwork Institute (AWI) and Quality Certification Program (QCP). Its differentiators include complimentary space planning, ergonomic assessments, a customizable in-house product line, and a network of premier manufacturing partners, all backed by over 50 years of experience.
